title: FORRT replication template
description:
Self-contained scaffold for FORRT replication studies: paper PDF in, Zenodo-archived release and Science Live nanopublication chain out. AI-guided via CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, pixi-based, with release workflows that record the version DOI and Software Heritage ID, and skills that use the forrt-research and replication-radar MCP servers.

This record archives the template itself. Repositories created from the template replace this file with their own metadata when initialised.
